CustomField.description: Set TRUE by Request Finance Override Quick Action. Used when Credit_Block__c = TRUE due to AR > 90 days overdue. Triggers email to Country Finance for one-time override approval.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use the Request Finance Override quick action to check this when the account has overdue AR and you need a one-time exception. Triggers a Finance approval request. Do not check manually.
CustomField.label: Credit Override Requested
